name: Yamaha
description: Yamaha brings its racing-bred R-series and FZ street range to Bangladesh through ACI Motors, blending blue-streak performance with everyday reliability.

name: Honda
description: The world's largest motorcycle maker, Honda fields commuters, the CB/CBR street line, and scooters, locally assembled and sold by Bangladesh Honda.

name: Suzuki
description: Suzuki's Gixxer family and commuters reach Bangladeshi riders via Rancon Motorbikes, known for sharp handling and dependable engineering.

name: Bajaj
description: Bajaj's Pulsar and Discover lines are a fixture on Bangladeshi roads, distributed by Uttara Motors with a reputation for value and torque.

name: TVS
description: TVS Auto Bangladesh fields the Apache RTR sport-commuters, Raider, and a wide scooter range backed by a deep service network.

name: Hero
description: Hero MotoCorp, the world's largest two-wheeler brand by volume, sells fuel-efficient commuters and the Xtreme line through Niloy Motors.

name: Royal Enfield
description: The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield's thumping 350cc classics bring retro character to Bangladesh.

name: KTM
description: Ready to Race — KTM brings rally-bred, single-cylinder Duke and RC machines to Bangladesh with sharp styling and aggressive performance.
